}}'''Mirala''' is the daughter of [[Thulin]] and [[Gallanha]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mirala}}

==Activities==
When her father, Thulin, sees the unnatural clouds, he packs up his family to go to help with the war in the north. On their way, they visit [[Renald Fanwar]].{{ref/book|12|p}}
